caption_L1: This is a bar chart titled Prevalence of asthma among Canadians from 2011 to 2012 , by province. The y-axis shows Percentage of people with asthma with linear scale from 0.00 to 0.12 while the x-axis shows Response as categorical scale starting at Alberta and ending at Yukon.
caption_L2L3: The prevalence of asthma is shown to be reasonably similar throughout the provinces of Canada. The exception to this is nunavut which had roughly half the cases as the rest of the country (0.04 per 100,000). The largest number were recorded in Nova Scotia and Ontario with both coming in at around 0.12.
